## How do I set up payroll and add employees?

<a id="setup-payroll"></a>

Turn payroll on, add each employee with their pay rate and tax settings, then enter anything already paid this year.

**Where:** **Accounting › Employees & payroll** (`/employees`)

1. Turn payroll on in Preferences > Payroll & Employees. → **Setup › Preferences** (`/settings`)
2. Open Employees & payroll and add each employee. → **Accounting › Employees & payroll** (`/employees`)
3. On the employee, under "Federal W-4", choose the Filing status and fill in the other lines from their Form W-4.
4. Choose the "State where the employee works". If they live or work in a place with its own income tax, click "+ Add a city or county tax" and pick it.
5. Open Payroll Setup for payroll items, state payroll taxes and, if you start mid-year, the year-to-date amounts already paid. → **Accounting › Payroll Setup** (`/employees/setup`)

> Good to know: Ironbooks works out paychecks and taxes and gives you the form figures. It does not file taxes or move money for you. Check tax tables against current rules.
>
> Good to know: City and county taxes: the common places have their rate built in. For a place that is not listed, choose "Other (not listed)" and type its name and rate. You can always type your own percent over a built-in rate.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I set up payroll and add employees?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I pay my employees?

<a id="run-payroll"></a>

Run payroll works out each paycheck, the taxes withheld and what you owe the government.

**Where:** **Accounting › Run payroll** (`/pay-runs`)

1. Open Run payroll and click "New Pay Run". → **Accounting › Run payroll** (`/pay-runs`)
2. Enter the Pay Date and the Period Start and Period End, and pick the employees. "Pull time" brings in hours from Time Tracking.
3. Check the paychecks, then click "Run Payroll".
4. Print the checks or the pay stubs. → **Accounting › Pay Stubs** (`/pay-stubs`)

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I pay my employees?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I pay payroll taxes?

<a id="pay-payroll-taxes"></a>

Pay payroll taxes records the payment of the taxes you withheld and owe to the government.

**Where:** **Accounting › Pay payroll taxes** (`/pay-liabilities`)

1. Open Pay payroll taxes. → **Accounting › Pay payroll taxes** (`/pay-liabilities`)
2. Under "Pay Payroll Liabilities by Item", pick what you are paying, the Payment Date and the Payment Account, then "Record Payment".
3. Make the actual payment to the agency yourself: Ironbooks records it, it does not send it.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I pay payroll taxes?", or ask Ask AI.*

## Where do I get W-2, 941 and 940 figures?

<a id="payroll-forms"></a>

Payroll Forms downloads the W-2, W-3, Form 941 and Form 940 figures from the payroll you ran.

**Where:** **Accounting › Payroll Forms** (`/payroll-forms`)

1. Open Payroll Forms. → **Accounting › Payroll Forms** (`/payroll-forms`)
2. Pick the form, the employee or quarter and the Tax Year, then download it.
3. Payroll Reports shows the totals behind the forms. → **Reports › Payroll Reports** (`/reports/payroll-summary`)

> Good to know: Verify the figures against current regulations before filing.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "Where do I get W-2, 941 and 940 figures?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I track hours worked?

<a id="time-tracking"></a>

Time Tracking records hours by employee, and by customer or job when you bill for time.

**Where:** **Operations › Time Tracking** (`/time-tracking`)

1. Open Time Tracking and click "Log Time". Pick the employee, the hours and, for billable work, the customer, service item and rate. → **Operations › Time Tracking** (`/time-tracking`)
2. To bill the customer: "Create Invoice from Billable Time" on the same screen.
3. To pay the hours: in a pay run, click "Pull time". → **Accounting › Run payroll** (`/pay-runs`)

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I track hours worked?", or ask Ask AI.*
